title: Cheesecake Brownies
changes_from_base: Cocoa brownie under a baked cream cheese layer, marbled on top; chilled.
summary: A cocoa brownie layer topped with smooth baked cheesecake and marbled with chocolate batter.
equipment: 20 cm square metal baking tin, lined with baking paper
heatproof bowl and small pan (or a microwave)

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
full-fat cream cheese, at room temperature

steps.title: Prepare
steps.text: Heat the oven to 170 °C (150 °C fan) and line the tin.

steps.title: Brownie
steps.text: Melt the butter in a pan, stir in the sugar until glossy, then off the heat stir in the cocoa, salt, baking powder and vanilla. Cool 5 min, beat in the eggs, then the flour, and fold in the chocolate chips. Spread all but 4 tbsp in the tin.

steps.title: Cheesecake
steps.text: Beat the cream cheese until lump-free, then the sugar and flour, then the cream, vanilla and egg until smooth. Pour evenly over the brownie layer.

steps.title: Marble
steps.text: Drop the saved brownie batter on top in small spoonfuls and pull a knife through a few times.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake 40-45 min, until the cheesecake layer is set at the edges with only a slight wobble in the middle and reads at least 71 °C.

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: Cool to room temperature, then chill at least 3 h before cutting into 16. Keep in the fridge.

tips: Soft cream cheese prevents lumps in the topping.
Wipe the knife between cuts for neat layers.
They taste best cold from the fridge.
safety: Don't taste the raw dough or batter: raw flour and raw egg aren't safe to eat until baked.
storage: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 4 days; let them stand 15 min before serving.
